data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Anatheia', meaning 'grace' or 'mercy'. In Christian tradition, this name represents tenderness, compassion, and divine favor. The name Anchie carries the meaning “Grace, merciful, tender” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anchie usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, merciful, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
